sub_graphs.title: EIP-6800: Fork Version Computation for P2P Compatibility
sub_graphs.description: Models how the compute_fork_version function is extended to include the EIP-6800 fork version, affecting P2P handshake, topic subscriptions, and peer compatibility checks.

nodes.label: Current Epoch Known
nodes.description: The node knows the current epoch from its local clock or chain state.

nodes.label: Compute Fork Version for Epoch
nodes.description: Evaluate current epoch against fork epoch thresholds in order: EIP6800, DENEB, CAPELLA, BELLATRIX, ALTAIR, GENESIS to determine the active fork version.

nodes.label: Active Fork Version Determined
nodes.description: The fork version byte sequence for the current epoch is determined, used in ForkDigest for P2P topics.

nodes.label: Derive Fork Digest
nodes.description: Combine fork version with genesis validators root to produce ForkDigest used in gossip topic names and ENR.

nodes.label: P2P Gossip Topics Active
nodes.description: Gossip topics incorporating the EIP-6800 fork digest are active; the node subscribes and publishes on these topics.

edges.label: Provide current epoch for version lookup
Use fork version for digest derivation
Subscribe to topics with new fork digest

external_entities.name: Peer Node
external_entities.description: Remote peer that must use the same fork digest for compatible P2P communication.

sub_graphs.title: EIP-6800: P2P Peer Compatibility Check
sub_graphs.description: Models the trust boundary at the P2P layer where peer fork versions are checked for compatibility during connection establishment.

nodes.label: Peer Connection Requested
nodes.description: An inbound or outbound P2P connection has been initiated with a remote peer.

nodes.label: Verify Peer Fork Digest Compatibility
nodes.description: Check that the remote peer's advertised fork digest matches the local node's expected fork digest for the current epoch.

nodes.label: Peer Fork Digest Compatible
nodes.description: The peer is on the same fork; communication can proceed.

nodes.label: Peer Fork Digest Incompatible
nodes.description: The peer is on a different fork; connection should be dropped or deprioritized.

external_entities.name: Remote Peer
external_entities.description: External network peer initiating or receiving a P2P connection, potentially on a different fork.

ambiguities.text: The P2P interface page provides only the compute_fork_version helper but does not detail specific gossip topics, request/response protocols, or message formats for EIP-6800.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume EIP-6800 inherits the standard Ethereum consensus P2P protocol (gossipsub topics, req/resp protocols) with only the fork version changed. Specific Verkle-tree-related messages may be defined elsewhere. This is an assumption.

implicit_assumptions.description: Peers transition to the EIP-6800 fork version at the correct epoch, maintaining network connectivity during the transition.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Peers stuck on a pre-EIP6800 fork version would be unable to communicate with upgraded peers, causing network partitioning.

implicit_assumptions.description: The fork version ordering in compute_fork_version is evaluated in descending order (newest first), ensuring the correct version is always selected.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If evaluation order is incorrect, a node might select an older fork version and be isolated from upgraded peers.
